definition: page_count is physical PDF pages. text_chars_no_space removes whitespace. unicode_token_count is a Unicode alphanumeric token proxy; latin_word_count counts Latin-script word tokens. Counts include references, captions, headers, footers, and extracted text artifacts; they are not publisher-authoritative manuscript word counts.
source: Official Snowmass 2021 Proceedings PDF URLs on SLAC eConf; arXiv/HAL fallback used only for malformed/missing archive links
